description: This file defines the API and data structures for I3C target device support in Zephyr OS, including configuration, callback functions, and registration routines.

methods.name: i3c_target_tx_write
methods.description: Writes data to the target's TX FIFO using the device driver.

methods.name: i3c_target_register
methods.description: Registers a target device with the I3C controller.

methods.name: i3c_target_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a target device from the I3C controller.
